name: Dr. Joseph Maina
text: Biocare Health Systems supplied and installed our Dymind hematology analyzer and hydraulic delivery beds. Their biomedical team completed on-site technician training and established a clear preventive maintenance schedule.

name: Sarah Chemutai
text: We rely on Biocare for routine Dymind DH36 reagent restocks and bi-annual calibration. Deliveries arrive on schedule and our diagnostic throughput remains steady.

name: Eng. Patrick Omwamba
text: The hydraulic obstetric beds and dental unit supplied by Biocare meet clinical build specifications and are straightforward to service. Spare parts availability through their Nairobi hub is reliable.
